name: Reply to “not now”
subjectVariants: Checking back later, if that suits you
bodyMd:
{{#if contact.firstName}}Hello {{contact.firstName}},{{else}}Hello,{{/if}}

Thank you for letting me know; I appreciate the straight answer. I understand this is not the moment, and I will not keep nudging.

Would it be all right if I checked back in a few months? If you would rather I did not, just say so and I will leave it there.

All the best with {{business.name}}.

Best regards,
